summary: Android TV application for browsing media content with custom rules.
usecases: Ad-free browsing of YouTube on Android TV devices
Customizing playback rules and skipping unwanted content segments
Managing media playback with user-defined preferences on smart TV

Add support for remote control gestures to trigger custom playback rules
